name: gocycling
description: Plan cycling, gravel and MTB routes on real OpenStreetMap data with gocycling.ai.

interface.longDescription: Plan, inspect, refine and export cycling routes on real OpenStreetMap data through the gocycling.ai MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 50 km gravel loop from Basel

positive.description: Plan one short paved loop for a road bike.
positive.prompt: Plan a 6 km loop from Basel SBB for a road bike, on paved roads.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one saved loop using the road-bike and paved-road preferences, targeting 6 km and measuring under 10 km. Report its actual distance and surface information honestly.

positive.description: Plan a short one-way ride on paved roads for a road bike. Use a separate conversation from case 1.
positive.prompt: Plan a road bike ride from Basel SBB to Basel Dreispitz station on paved roads, under 10 km.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one one-way ride between the stations, using a road bike and paved-road preference, with measured distance under 10 km. Do not add a return leg.

positive.description: Continue the conversation from case 1 and add one café stop; reuse its saved loop.
positive.prompt: Add a café stop about halfway around the loop. Keep the whole ride under 10 km.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a real café near the measured midpoint and add it to a new version of the existing loop, preserving the road bike, paved-road preference and start. Report its actual position and the new distance; if no suitable stop fits under 10 km, explain that and keep the original.

positive.description: Continue the loop conversation from case 3 and change its traffic preference without starting a new trip.
positive.prompt: Avoid busy roads on that loop. Keep it under 10 km.
positive.expected_behavior: Refine the existing loop to avoid busy roads while retaining its road bike, paved-road preference, café stop, start and distance target. Report the resulting measured distance and any unmet preference; the route must remain under 10 km.

positive.description: Import a tiny three-point GPX and obtain its owner download link.
positive.prompt: Import this GPX and give me its download link: <gpx version="1.1" creator="review-fixture" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1"><trk><name>Review track</name><trkseg><trkpt lat="47.5500" lon="7.5900"><ele>270</ele></trkpt><trkpt lat="47.5510" lon="7.5910"><ele>275</ele></trkpt><trkpt lat="47.5520" lon="7.5920"><ele>272</ele></trkpt></trkseg></trk></gpx>
positive.expected_behavior: Import the three-point track without rerouting it and return the owner GPX download link for that same route. Do not claim that returning the link saved a file on the reviewer’s device.

negative.description: Handle an unsupported flight-booking request. Explain that the plugin cannot book flights, and do not claim that a reservation or purchase was made.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Zurich to Lisbon next Friday.

negative.description: Handle an unsupported calendar-change request. Explain that the plugin cannot read or change the calendar, and do not claim that the meeting was moved.
negative.prompt: Move my team meeting to 10 tomorrow morning.

negative.description: Handle a standalone live-weather request. Explain that the plugin cannot provide a verified standalone live forecast, and do not invent current weather or claim to have checked a forecast.
negative.prompt: What is the live weather forecast in Basel for tomorrow? I do not need a route.
